rancher.title: Rancher
rancher.description: Configuration for the upstream Rancher Helm chart.

hostname.title: Hostname
hostname.description: Fully-qualified DNS name used to reach the Rancher UI/API (must resolve to your ingress).

bootstrapPassword.title: Bootstrap password
bootstrapPassword.description: Initial password for the local 'admin' user (recommended at least 12 characters). If left empty, Rancher generates a random one stored in the 'bootstrap-secret' secret.

replicas.title: Replicas
replicas.description: Number of Rancher replicas. Use 3 for HA; set to 1 for single-node clusters.

source.title: TLS certificate source
source.description: rancher = self-signed via cert-manager; letsEncrypt = public certs via cert-manager; secret = bring your own TLS secret.

letsEncrypt.title: Let's Encrypt
letsEncrypt.description: Only used when TLS certificate source is letsEncrypt.

email.title: Email
email.description: Contact email used to register the Let's Encrypt account (required when TLS source is letsEncrypt).

privateCA.title: Private CA
privateCA.description: Set to true when the certificate is signed by a private CA.
